import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim, n_heads, dim_head=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, n_heads)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(dim, dim * 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(dim * 4, dim)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(x, x, x)
        x = self.norm1(x + attn_out)
        ff_out = self.ff(x)
        x = self.norm2(x + ff_out)
        return x

import chromadb
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

# Initialize model and client
model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
client = chromadb.Client()

# Create collection
collection = client.create_collection(name='documents')

# Add documents with embeddings
documents = [
    'KAI-LLM is a domain-specialized LLM for AI/ML engineering.',
    'Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence.',
    'Transformers have revolutionized NLP tasks.',
]
embeddings = model.encode(documents)

collection.add(
    ids=[str(i) for i in range(len(documents))],
    embeddings=embeddings.tolist(),
    documents=documents
)

# Query similar documents
results = collection.query(
    query_embeddings=[model.encode(['What is AI?'])][0],
    n_results=2
)
print('Retrieved results:', results)
